text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on February 19, 2020. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, acknowledged the families and Toronto Fire Service colleagues, of Douglas Burlie and Daniel D'Aloisio, who were present in the Chamber. Councillor Filion, during the morning session of the meeting, welcomed the Willowdale Youth Council who were present in the Chamber. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Tory and Councillor Pasternak to come forward for a special presentation. Councillor Pasternak advised Members of Council that after 33 years of service to the City of Toronto, Richard Ubbens, Director of Parks, was leaving the City for a senior level position at the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.
